note: P15's oracle: the hysteresis of chapter 15 figure 15.4. Each case feeds a sequence of nearest-valid distances in millimetres and states the state after every frame, by name. NO_TARGET is written as 65535. The default policy is the chapter's: far 1500, enter 800, leave 950, three of five. Cases that name a policy override it. Hand written from the figure's four edges and the two the figure does not draw, then checked against properties that come from neither implementation.

cases.why: crossing 1500 enters approaching at once, with no confirmation
three of five under 800 confirms present, and not before
two under 800 out of five is not enough, however close
three consecutive under 800 confirms on the third
present does not leave on one frame over 950, which is the whole point
three over 950 leaves, and the window was cleared on entry to present
a target that comes back while leaving is present again at once
leaving returns to clear only past 1500
approaching returns to clear if the target leaves range unconfirmed
sitting exactly on 800 is NOT under it, so it never confirms
sitting exactly on 950 is NOT over it, so present stays
a target hovering between the two thresholds never changes state, which is the hysteresis doing its job
one of one confirmation makes the inner edges immediate
leave below enter has no hysteresis and is refused
needing more agreeing frames than the window holds is refused
a window of zero is refused
a window above the maximum the bitmask holds is refused
